subject: 15 Hadley Place Lot Line Reconfiguration
overview: The board approved a lot line reconfiguration for 15 Hadley Place to facilitate a proposed five-unit residential project and discussed new procedural requirements for reviewing city special permits. Staff also provided updates on upcoming developments at 100 Winchester and Tufts University, alongside board membership changes.

items.title: 15 Hadley Place A&R Plan
items.summary: Approved an Approval Not Required (A&R) plan to reconfigure lot lines for 15 Hadley Place and 6 Franklin Street, creating a larger lot to accommodate an addition to an existing building for a total of five residential units. Attorney Kathleen Desmond and applicant Frank Capone addressed board questions regarding a narrow parcel sliver used for frontage and confirmed that the project would likely seek future setback relief from the Board of Appeals.

items.title: Staff Updates and Upcoming Business
items.summary: Staff announced upcoming hearings for a mixed-use project at 100 Winchester and Tufts University tennis courts, while noting that a petition for 11 Paul Road requires re-advertising for a full public hearing. The board was also informed of the appointment of a new full member and the board's first associate member to fill existing vacancies.

items.title: Special Permit Review Procedures
items.summary: Planning Director Alicia Hunt briefed the board on a new zoning ordinance requirement that mandates the Community Development Board provide advisory comments on all special permits issued by the City Council or Zoning Board of Appeals. This procedural change ensures the board reviews projects that do not otherwise trigger full site plan review, such as small-scale marijuana establishments.
